description: Add a source to a project's register, or change one — its key, authors, title, year, venue, identifiers or PDF — or say how far it is checked. A source is named by 'id', or by 'project' and 'key': one that does not exist yet is created (with 'title'), unchecked. A field left out keeps its value and an empty one clears it; 'authors' given replaces the whole list. Identifiers are kept in one shape whatever they are pasted as (arXiv without 'arXiv:' and with its version, a DOI without https://doi.org/, 'MR' and digits, zbMATH without 'Zbl', an ISBN's digits with its checksum held), and each is once per project — a second source with the same one is refused, naming the first. 'check' moves the check by hand, with a line in its journal: 'manual' (you checked it against the original — say against what in 'reason'), 'mismatch' (it disagrees with what it names — 'reason' says how; required) or 'unchecked'; 'api' is written only by the check against the services. Changing the authors, title, year, venue or an identifier of a checked source takes it back to unchecked: what was checked is no longer there. Members of the project who may write only.

arxiv.description: The arXiv id, with its version where it matters: '2301.01234v3', 'math/0601001'.

authors.description: Its authors in the work's order, as a JSON array replacing the list: [{"name":"N. D. Gupta"},{"name":"S. Sidki","person":42}] — 'name' as the work prints it, 'person' a person of the project's register you may see (find_person), optional. A person without a name takes the name the register shows.

check.description: How far it is checked, by hand: 'manual', 'mismatch' or 'unchecked'.

id.description: The source to change, as list_sources returned it. Or name it by 'project' and 'key'.

isbn.description: The ISBN, ten or thirteen digits.

key.description: The source's key, e.g. 'IMP26' — a letter or digit, then letters, digits and ':', '.', '_', '-', '+'; once per project, case aside.

newKey.description: A new key for an existing source.

pdfAttachment.description: Its PDF: the id of an issue's attachment you may open; 0 takes the PDF off.

pdfWikiAttachment.description: Its PDF: the id of a wiki page's attachment you may open; 0 takes the PDF off.

reason.description: With 'check': against what it was checked, or how it disagrees — at most 1000 characters.

venue.description: The journal, series or publisher, e.g. 'Ann. of Math.'.

year.description: The year it appeared; 0 clears it.

name: set_source
title: Set source
